const RJX_MEMORY_STORAGE={};function rjxStoreGet(k){try{return localStorage.getItem(k)}catch(e){return Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(RJX_MEMORY_STORAGE,k)?RJX_MEMORY_STORAGE[k]:null}}function rjxStoreSet(k,v){try{localStorage.setItem(k,v)}catch(e){RJX_MEMORY_STORAGE[k]=String(v)}}function storage(){try{return JSON.parse(rjxStoreGet('rjxProgress')||'{}')}catch(e){return {}}}function saveStorage(x){rjxStoreSet('rjxProgress',JSON.stringify(x))}function draftGet(k){return rjxStoreGet(k)||''}function draftSet(k,v){rjxStoreSet(k,v)}
function markDone(key){const s=storage();s.done=s.done||{};s.done[key]=true;s.last=key;saveStorage(s)}
function addMistake(key,q,answer,why){const s=storage();s.mistakes=s.mistakes||[];s.mistakes.unshift({key,q,answer,why,date:new Date().toISOString()});s.mistakes=s.mistakes.slice(0,50);saveStorage(s)}
function doneCount(){const s=storage();return Object.keys(s.done||{}).length}
function closeMobile(){nav.classList.remove('open');const t=document.getElementById('mobileToggle');if(t)t.textContent='☰'}
function setNav(route){nav.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(a=>a.classList.remove('active'));let sel=route;if(['member','section'].includes(route))sel='members';if(['book','group'].includes(route))sel='lessons';const map={home:'#home',lessons:'#lessons',practice:'#practice',exams:'#exams',members:'#members',about:'#levels',contact:'#contact'};if(map[sel])nav.querySelector(`a[href="${map[sel]}"]`)?.classList.add('active')}
function show(route){state.route=route;if(route==='home'){home.style.display='';internal.style.display='none';document.querySelectorAll('.rjx-page').forEach(p=>p.classList.remove('active'));setNav('home');closeMobile();scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'});return;}home.style.display='none';internal.style.display='block';document.querySelectorAll('.rjx-page').forEach(p=>p.classList.remove('active'));document.getElementById(pageMap[route]).classList.add('active');setNav(route);closeMobile();renderRoute(route);scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'})}
function renderRoute(r){if(r==='lessons')renderPublicLessons();if(r==='practice')renderPublicPractice();if(r==='exams')renderExams();if(r==='members')renderMembers();if(r==='about')renderAbout();if(r==='book')renderBook();if(r==='group')renderGroup();if(r==='free')renderFree();if(r==='member')renderMember();if(r==='section')renderSection();if(r==='contact')renderContact()}
function button(label,fn,cls='rjx-btn'){const b=document.createElement('button');b.className=cls;b.textContent=label;b.onclick=fn;return b}
function modal(k,t,body){document.getElementById('rjxModalKicker').textContent=k;document.getElementById('rjxModalTitle').textContent=t;document.getElementById('rjxModalBody').innerHTML=body;document.getElementById('rjxModal').classList.add('open');document.body.style.overflow='hidden'}function closeModal(){document.getElementById('rjxModal').classList.remove('open');document.body.style.overflow='';clearInterval(state.timer)}document.getElementById('rjxModalClose').onclick=closeModal;document.getElementById('rjxModal').onclick=e=>{if(e.target.id==='rjxModal')closeModal()};
function crumbs(items){return `<div class="rjx-toolbar"><div class="rjx-breadcrumb">${items.map((x,i)=>i===items.length-1?`<strong>${x[0]}</strong>`:`<button data-crumb="${x[1]}">${x[0]}</button> <span>›</span> `).join('')}</div></div>`}
function wireCrumbs(root=document){root.querySelectorAll('[data-crumb]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{const x=b.dataset.crumb;if(x==='member')show('member');else if(x==='members')show('members');else if(x==='section')show('section');else show(x)})}

The final live Stripe subscription/payment link still needs to be connected before publishing.</div>`)}

function renderContact(){
  const root=document.getElementById('rjxContactBody');
  const contactEmail='rjlanguageacademy@agentmail.to';
  root.innerHTML=`
    <div class="rjx-contact-help">
      <div class="rjx-card"><div class="rjx-tag">LESSONS</div><h3>Lesson questions</h3><p>Ask about private lessons, group lessons, availability or the best course for you.</p></div>
      <div class="rjx-card"><div class="rjx-tag">MEMBERSHIP</div><h3>Member support</h3><p>Tell us if a lesson, quiz, membership page or saved-progress feature is not working as expected.</p></div>
      <div class="rjx-card"><div class="rjx-tag">GENERAL</div><h3>General enquiries</h3><p>Use the form for partnerships, resources, feedback or any other RJ Language Academy question.</p></div>
    </div>
    <div class="rjx-grid2">
      <div class="rjx-card">
        <div class="rjx-tag">CONTACT US</div><h2>Send us a message</h2>
        <p>Your email app will open with your message prepared and addressed to RJ Language Academy.</p>
        <div class="rjx-form">
          <div><div class="rjx-label">Name</div><input class="rjx-input" id="cName" autocomplete="name" placeholder="Your name"></div>
          <div><div class="rjx-label">Email</div><input class="rjx-input" type="email" id="cEmail" autocomplete="email" placeholder="you@example.com"></div>
          <div><div class="rjx-label">What can we help with?</div><select class="rjx-input" id="cTopic"><option>General enquiry</option><option>Lesson question</option><option>Membership support</option><option>Technical problem</option><option>IELTS / TOEIC</option><option>Partnership</option></select></div>
          <div><div class="rjx-label">Message</div><textarea class="rjx-textarea" id="cMsg" placeholder="Tell us what you need help with..."></textarea></div>
          <div class="rjx-actions"><button class="rjx-btn primary" id="cSend">Open email & send</button><button class="rjx-btn" id="cCopy">Copy message</button></div>
          <div id="cStatus" aria-live="polite"></div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="rjx-card">
        <div class="rjx-tag">DIRECT EMAIL</div><h3>RJ Language Academy</h3>
        <p>If you prefer, email us directly:</p>
        <p><a class="rjx-link" href="mailto:${contactEmail}">${contactEmail}</a></p>
        <div class="rjx-note"><strong>Support tip:</strong> if you are reporting a website problem, include the page name, what you clicked and what happened.</div>
      </div>
    </div>`;
  const buildMessage=()=>{
    const name=document.getElementById('cName').value.trim();
    const email=document.getElementById('cEmail').value.trim();
    const topic=document.getElementById('cTopic').value;
    const msg=document.getElementById('cMsg').value.trim();
    return {name,email,topic,msg,body:`Name: ${name||'Not supplied'}\nEmail: ${email||'Not supplied'}\nTopic: ${topic}\n\nMessage:\n${msg}`};
  };
  document.getElementById('cSend').onclick=()=>{
    const d=buildMessage(),status=document.getElementById('cStatus');
    if(!d.name||!d.email||!d.msg){status.innerHTML='<div class="rjx-feedback bad">Please add your name, email address and message before sending.</div>';return}
    if(!/^\\S+@\\S+\\.\\S+$/.test(d.email)){status.innerHTML='<div class="rjx-feedback bad">Please enter a valid email address.</div>';return}
    const subject=`RJ Language Academy — ${d.topic}`;
    const uri=`mailto:${contactEmail}?subject=${encodeURIComponent(subject)}&body=${encodeURIComponent(d.body)}`;
    status.innerHTML='<div class="rjx-feedback good">Opening your email app with the message prepared…</div>';
    window.location.href=uri;
  };
  document.getElementById('cCopy').onclick=async()=>{
    const d=buildMessage(),status=document.getElementById('cStatus');
    try{await navigator.clipboard.writeText(d.body);status.innerHTML='<div class="rjx-feedback good">Message copied. You can paste it into any email app.</div>'}
    catch(e){status.innerHTML='<div class="rjx-feedback">Copy is blocked in this browser. Select the message text manually instead.</div>'}
  };
}

class="rjx-toolbar"><strong>Free practice journey</strong><span>${state.freeDone.size} of ${RJX_FREE.length} completed</span></div><div class="rjx-progress-track"><div class="rjx-progress-bar" style="width:${pct}%"></div></div><div style="height:14px"></div><div class="rjx-practice-box"><div class="rjx-tag">${a.skill} · ${a.level} · ${a.minutes} MIN</div><h3>${a.title}</h3>${a.passage?`<p>${a.passage}</p>`:''}<div id="freeWork"></div></div><div class="rjx-bottom-nav"><button class="rjx-btn" id="freePrev">← Previous</button><span>Activity ${state.free+1} of ${RJX_FREE.length}</span><button class="rjx-btn primary next" id="freeNext">${state.free===RJX_FREE.length-1?'Finish':'Next activity →'}</button></div>`;const w=document.getElementById('freeWork');if(a.speaking){w.innerHTML=`<p>${a.prompt}</p><div class="rjx-timer" id="freeTimer">01:00</div><button class="rjx-btn primary" id="freeTimerBtn">Start 60-second timer</button>`;document.getElementById('freeTimerBtn').onclick=()=>startTimer('freeTimer',()=>{state.freeDone.add(state.free);renderFree()})}else{w.innerHTML=`<strong>${a.question}</strong><div class="rjx-options" style="margin-top:10px">${a.options.map((o,i)=>`<button class="rjx-option" data-free-option="${i}">${o}</button>`).join('')}</div><div class="rjx-feedback" id="freeFb"></div>`;w.querySelectorAll('[data-free-option]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{const chosen=+b.dataset.freeOption,opts=[...w.querySelectorAll('[data-free-option]')];if(opts.some(x=>x.disabled))return;opts.forEach((x,i)=>{x.disabled=true;if(i===a.correct)x.classList.add('correct')});if(chosen!==a.correct){b.classList.add('wrong');window.rjxPlayWrong?.()}else{window.rjxPlayCorrect?.()}const f=document.getElementById('freeFb');f.textContent=a.feedback;f.classList.add('show');state.freeDone.add(state.free)})}document.getElementById('freePrev').disabled=state.free===0;document.getElementById('freePrev').onclick=()=>{if(state.free>0){state.free--;renderFree()}};document.getElementById('freeNext').onclick=()=>{if(!state.freeDone.has(state.free)){modal('FREE PRACTICE','Complete this activity first','<p>Answer the question or finish the speaking timer before moving on.</p>');return}if(state.free<RJX_FREE.length-1){state.free++;renderFree()}else{modal('FREE PRACTICE COMPLETE','Nice work.',`<p>You have completed the free sampler.</p><div class="rjx-actions"><button class="rjx-btn primary" id="freeJoin">Explore Membership →</button></div>`);document.getElementById('freeJoin').onclick=()=>{closeModal();show('members')}}}}

function renderMemberLessons(root){const st=state.lesson;if(st.index!==null)return renderLessonDetail(root);if(st.unit!==null)return renderLessonUnit(root);if(st.level && st.unit===null && st._showUnits)return renderLessonUnits(root);root.innerHTML=sectionCrumb('Lessons')+`<div class="rjx-head"><div><h2>Choose your level</h2><p>Each level contains six units and 36 individual lessons. Open a level to see the unit names, then the lesson titles inside each unit.</p></div></div><div class="rjx-grid3">${Object.keys(RJX_LESSONS).map(l=>{const sample=RJX_LESSONS[l].flatMap(u=>u.lessons).slice(0,4).map(x=>x.title).join(' · ');return `<div class="rjx-card click" data-lvl="${l}"><div class="rjx-tag">${l} · ${RJX_LEVEL_NAMES[l]}</div><h3>6 units · 36 lessons</h3><p>${sample} · …</p><span class="rjx-link">Open all ${l} lessons →</span></div>`}).join('')}</div>`;wireCrumbs(root);root.querySelectorAll('[data-lvl]').forEach(c=>c.onclick=()=>{state.lesson={level:c.dataset.lvl,unit:null,index:null,_showUnits:true};renderMemberLessons(root)})}
function renderLessonUnits(root){const l=state.lesson.level,units=RJX_LESSONS[l];root.innerHTML=crumbs([['Memberships','members'],[TIER[state.tier].name,'member'],['Lessons','section'],[`${l} ${RJX_LEVEL_NAMES[l]}`,'section']])+`<div class="rjx-toolbar"><strong>${l} ${RJX_LEVEL_NAMES[l]} · 36 lessons</strong><button class="rjx-btn" id="allLevels">← All levels</button></div><div class="rjx-grid2">${units.map((u,i)=>`<div class="rjx-card click" data-unit="${i}"><div class="rjx-tag">UNIT ${i+1} · ${u.skill}</div><h3>${u.name}</h3><p>${u.lessons.map((x,j)=>`${j+1}. ${x.title}`).slice(0,4).join(' · ')}${u.lessons.length>4?' · …':''}</p><span class="rjx-link">Open all ${u.lessons.length} lessons →</span></div>`).join('')}</div><div class="rjx-bottom-nav"><button class="rjx-btn" id="levelPrev">← Previous level</button><span>${l} · ${RJX_LEVEL_NAMES[l]}</span><button class="rjx-btn primary next" id="levelNext">Next level →</button></div>`;wireCrumbs(root);const keys=Object.keys(RJX_LESSONS),li=keys.indexOf(l);document.getElementById('allLevels').onclick=()=>{state.lesson={level:null,unit:null,index:null,_showUnits:false};renderMemberLessons(root)};document.getElementById('levelPrev').disabled=li===0;document.getElementById('levelNext').disabled=li===keys.length-1;document.getElementById('levelPrev').onclick=()=>{state.lesson={level:keys[li-1],unit:null,index:null,_showUnits:true};renderMemberLessons(root)};document.getElementById('levelNext').onclick=()=>{state.lesson={level:keys[li+1],unit:null,index:null,_showUnits:true};renderMemberLessons(root)};root.querySelectorAll('[data-unit]').forEach(c=>c.onclick=()=>{state.lesson.unit=+c.dataset.unit;state.lesson.index=null;renderMemberLessons(root)})}
function renderLessonUnit(root){const l=state.lesson.level,u=RJX_LESSONS[l][state.lesson.unit];root.innerHTML=crumbs([['Memberships','members'],[TIER[state.tier].name,'member'],['Lessons','section'],[l,'section'],[u.name,'section']])+`<div class="rjx-toolbar"><div><strong>${l} · Unit ${state.lesson.unit+1}: ${u.name}</strong><br><small>${u.skill}</small></div><button class="rjx-btn" id="backUnits">← Back to ${l} units</button></div><div class="rjx-list">${u.lessons.map((x,i)=>`<div class="rjx-row click" data-lesson="${i}"><div><strong>${i+1}. ${x.title}</strong><small>${x.skill} · explanation, examples, task and quick check</small></div><span class="rjx-chip">Open lesson</span></div>`).join('')}</div><div class="rjx-bottom-nav"><button class="rjx-btn" id="prevUnit">← Previous unit</button><span>Unit ${state.lesson.unit+1} of ${RJX_LESSONS[l].length}</span><button class="rjx-btn primary next" id="nextUnit">Next unit →</button></div>`;wireCrumbs(root);document.getElementById('backUnits').onclick=()=>{state.lesson.unit=null;state.lesson._showUnits=true;renderMemberLessons(root)};document.getElementById('prevUnit').disabled=state.lesson.unit===0;document.getElementById('nextUnit').disabled=state.lesson.unit===RJX_LESSONS[l].length-1;document.getElementById('prevUnit').onclick=()=>{state.lesson.unit--;renderMemberLessons(root)};document.getElementById('nextUnit').onclick=()=>{state.lesson.unit++;renderMemberLessons(root)};root.querySelectorAll('[data-lesson]').forEach(c=>c.onclick=()=>{state.lesson.index=+c.dataset.lesson;renderMemberLessons(root)})}
function renderLessonDetail(root){
  const l=state.lesson.level,u=RJX_LESSONS[l][state.lesson.unit],x=u.lessons[state.lesson.index];
  const levels=Object.keys(RJX_LESSONS), li=levels.indexOf(l), ui=state.lesson.unit, xi=state.lesson.index;
  function adjacent(dir){
    let L=li,U=ui,X=xi+dir;
    if(dir>0){
      if(X<RJX_LESSONS[levels[L]][U].lessons.length)return {level:levels[L],unit:U,index:X};
      U++; X=0;
      if(U<RJX_LESSONS[levels[L]].length)return {level:levels[L],unit:U,index:X};
      L++; U=0; X=0;
      if(L<levels.length)return {level:levels[L],unit:U,index:X};
      return null;
    }
    if(X>=0)return {level:levels[L],unit:U,index:X};
    U--;
    if(U>=0)return {level:levels[L],unit:U,index:RJX_LESSONS[levels[L]][U].lessons.length-1};
    L--;
    if(L>=0){U=RJX_LESSONS[levels[L]].length-1;return {level:levels[L],unit:U,index:RJX_LESSONS[levels[L]][U].lessons.length-1};}
    return null;
  }
  const prev=adjacent(-1), next=adjacent(1);
  root.innerHTML=crumbs([['Memberships','members'],[TIER[state.tier].name,'member'],['Lessons','section'],[l,'section'],[u.name,'section'],[x.title,'section']])+`<article class="rjx-lesson"><div class="rjx-lesson-head"><div class="rjx-tag">${l} · UNIT ${state.lesson.unit+1} · LESSON ${state.lesson.index+1}</div><h2>${x.title}</h2><p>${x.goal||''}</p></div><div class="rjx-lesson-body"><h3>Learn</h3><p>${x.teach}</p><h3>Examples</h3><div class="rjx-examples">${(x.examples||[]).map(e=>`<div>${e}</div>`).join('')}</div><h3>Your task</h3><div class="rjx-task">${x.task}</div><h3>Model answer</h3><p>${x.model}</p><h3>Quick check</h3>${(x.questions||[]).map((q,qi)=>`<div class="rjx-q"><strong>${qi+1}. ${q[0]}</strong><div class="rjx-options">${q[1].map((o,oi)=>`<button class="rjx-option" data-q="${qi}" data-o="${oi}">${o}</button>`).join('')}</div><div class="rjx-feedback" id="lfb${qi}"></div></div>`).join('')}<div style="margin-top:18px"><button class="rjx-btn primary" id="markLesson">Mark lesson complete</button></div></div></article><div class="rjx-bottom-nav">${prev?'<button class="rjx-btn" id="lessonPrev">← Previous lesson</button>':'<span></span>'}<span>${l} · Unit ${ui+1} · Lesson ${xi+1}</span>${next?'<button class="rjx-btn primary next" id="lessonNext">Next lesson →</button>':'<span class="rjx-chip">End of A1–C2 course ✓</span>'}</div><div style="margin-top:10px"><button class="rjx-btn" id="backUnit">← Back to ${u.name}</button></div>`;
  wireCrumbs(root);
  root.querySelectorAll('[data-q]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{const qi=+b.dataset.q,oi=+b.dataset.o,q=x.questions[qi],opts=[...root.querySelectorAll(`[data-q="${qi}"]`)];if(opts.some(o=>o.disabled))return;opts.forEach((o,i)=>{o.disabled=true;if(i===q[2])o.classList.add('correct')});if(oi!==q[2]){b.classList.add('wrong');window.rjxPlayWrong?.();addMistake(`lesson-${l}-${ui}-${xi}-${qi}`,q[0],q[1][q[2]],q[3])}else{window.rjxPlayCorrect?.()}const f=document.getElementById('lfb'+qi);f.textContent=q[3];f.classList.add('show')});
  document.getElementById('markLesson').onclick=()=>{markDone(`lesson-${l}-${ui}-${xi}`);document.getElementById('markLesson').textContent='✓ Lesson completed'};
  const go=t=>{state.lesson={level:t.level,unit:t.unit,index:t.index,_showUnits:true};renderMemberLessons(root);window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'})};
  if(prev)document.getElementById('lessonPrev').onclick=()=>go(prev);
  if(next)document.getElementById('lessonNext').onclick=()=>go(next);
  document.getElementById('backUnit').onclick=()=>{state.lesson.index=null;renderMemberLessons(root)};
}

class="rjx-lesson-head"><div class="rjx-tag">READ & WRITE · ${u.level}</div><h2>${x.title}</h2></div><div class="rjx-lesson-body"><h3>Learn</h3><p>${x.teach}</p><h3>Your task</h3><div u=RJX_READWRITE[st.unit];root.innerHTML=sectionCrumb(`${u.level} · ${u.title}`)+`<div class="rjx-toolbar"><strong>${u.level} · ${u.title}</strong><button class="rjx-btn" id="rwAll">← All draft</small></div><span class="rjx-chip">Open</span></div>`).join('')}</div>`;wireCrumbs(root);document.getElementById('rwAll').onclick=()=>{st.unit=null;renderReadWrite(root)};root.querySelectorAll('[data-rw]').forEach(x=>x.onclick=()=>{st.index=+x.dataset.rw;renderReadWrite(root)});return}root.innerHTML=sectionCrumb('Read & Write')+`<div class="rjx-head"><div><h2>Read & Write mega-course</h2><p>25 units across A1–C1. Each unit contains six lesson/activity pages — 150 pages in total.</p></div></div><div class="rjx-grid3">${RJX_READWRITE.map((u,i)=>`<div class="rjx-card click" data-rwu="${i}"><div class="rjx-tag">${u.level}</div><h3>${u.title}</h3><p>6 parts with reading/writing guidance and saved drafts.</p><span class="rjx-link">Open unit →</span></div>`).join('')}</div>`;wireCrumbs(root);root.querySelectorAll('[data-rwu]').forEach(x=>x.onclick=()=>{st.unit=+x.dataset.rwu;renderReadWrite(root)})}

function renderExamCentre(root,sec){
  const isToeic=sec==='toeic';
  const mods=sec==='advanced-exams'?[...RJX_IELTS,...RJX_TOEIC]:isToeic?RJX_TOEIC:RJX_IELTS;
  const name=sec==='advanced-exams'?'Advanced IELTS & TOEIC Library':isToeic?'TOEIC Centre':'IELTS Centre';

  if(state.exam.sec!==sec){state.exam={sec,index:null}}

  if(state.exam.index===null){
    const intro=isToeic
      ?'Open any TOEIC module below. Each one now contains strategy teaching, a model/example and interactive questions.'
      :sec==='advanced-exams'
        ?'A combined IELTS and TOEIC library with interactive modules rather than placeholder cards.'
        :'Open any IELTS module below. Each one now contains strategy teaching, a model/example and interactive questions.';
    root.innerHTML=sectionCrumb(name)+`
      <div class="rjx-head"><div><h2>${name}</h2><p>${intro}</p></div></div>
      <div class="rjx-grid2">${mods.map((m,i)=>{
        const tag=sec==='advanced-exams'?(i<RJX_IELTS.length?'IELTS':'TOEIC'):(isToeic?'TOEIC':'IELTS');
        const bank=RJX_EXAM_BANK[m[0]];
        const completed=!!storage().done?.[`exam-${sec}-${i}`];
        return `<div class="rjx-card click" data-exmod="${i}">
          <div class="rjx-tag">${tag} · ${completed?'✓ COMPLETED':'INTERACTIVE'}</div>
          <h3>${m[0]}</h3>
          <p>${m[1]}</p>
          <small style="display:block;color:#748196;margin-top:8px">${bank?.questions?.length||0} quick-check questions inside</small>
          <span class="rjx-link">${completed?'Review module':'Open module'} →</span>
        </div>`;
      }).join('')}</div>
      <div class="rjx-note"><strong>These modules now work:</strong> open a card to study the strategy, see an example and answer the questions. Green answers play a bell; red answers play the wrong-answer buzzer.</div>`;
    wireCrumbs(root);
    root.querySelectorAll('[data-exmod]').forEach(c=>c.onclick=()=>{
      state.exam={sec,index:+c.dataset.exmod};
      renderExamCentre(root,sec);
      window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'});
    });
    return;
  }

  const idx=state.exam.index;
  const m=mods[idx];
  const d=RJX_EXAM_BANK[m[0]];
  const tag=sec==='advanced-exams'?(idx<RJX_IELTS.length?'IELTS':'TOEIC'):(isToeic?'TOEIC':'IELTS');

  root.innerHTML=sectionCrumb(name)+`
    <div class="rjx-toolbar">
      <div><strong>${tag} · ${m[0]}</strong><br><small>Interactive exam module ${idx+1} of ${mods.length}</small></div>
      <button class="rjx-btn" id="examBack">← Back to ${name}</button>
    </div>

    <article class="rjx-lesson">
      <div class="rjx-lesson-head">
        <div class="rjx-tag">${tag} · EXAM SKILL</div>
        <h2>${m[0]}</h2>
        <p>${m[1]}</p>
      </div>
      <div class="rjx-lesson-body">
        <h3>Learn the strategy</h3>
        <p>${d.teach}</p>

        <h3>Key steps</h3>
        <div class="rjx-checklist">${d.strategy.map(x=>`<div class="rjx-check">✓ ${x}</div>`).join('')}</div>

        <h3>Model / example</h3>
        <div class="rjx-task">${d.model}</div>

        <h3>Quick check</h3>
        ${d.questions.map((q,qi)=>`
          <div class="rjx-q">
            <strong>${qi+1}. ${q[0]}</strong>
            <div class="rjx-options">
              ${q[1].map((o,oi)=>`<button class="rjx-option" data-exq="${qi}" data-exo="${oi}">${o}</button>`).join('')}
            </div>
            <div class="rjx-feedback" id="exfb${qi}"></div>
          </div>`).join('')}

        <div style="margin-top:18px">
          <button class="rjx-btn primary" id="examComplete">${idx<mods.length-1?'Complete & continue →':(isToeic?'Complete TOEIC Centre ✓':'Complete '+name+' ✓')}</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </article>

    <div class="rjx-bottom-nav">
      <button class="rjx-btn" id="examPrev">← Previous module</button>
      <span>Module ${idx+1} of ${mods.length}</span>
      ${idx<mods.length-1?'<button class="rjx-btn primary next" id="examNext">Next module →</button>':'<span class="rjx-chip">Final module</span>'}
    </div>`;

  wireCrumbs(root);

  root.querySelectorAll('[data-exq]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{
    const qi=+b.dataset.exq, oi=+b.dataset.exo, q=d.questions[qi];
    const opts=[...root.querySelectorAll(`[data-exq="${qi}"]`)];
    if(opts.some(x=>x.disabled))return;
    opts.forEach((x,i)=>{
      x.disabled=true;
      if(i===q[2])x.classList.add('correct');
    });
    if(oi!==q[2]){
      b.classList.add('wrong');
      window.rjxPlayWrong?.();
      addMistake(`exam-${sec}-${idx}-${qi}`,q[0],q[1][q[2]],q[3]);
    }else{
      window.rjxPlayCorrect?.();
    }
    const f=document.getElementById('exfb'+qi);
    f.textContent=q[3];
    f.classList.add('show');
  });

  document.getElementById('examComplete').onclick=()=>{
    markDone(`exam-${sec}-${idx}`);
    if(idx<mods.length-1){
      state.exam.index=idx+1;
      renderExamCentre(root,sec);
      window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'});
      return;
    }
    // Final module: never leave the learner at a dead end.
    state.exam={sec,index:null};
    renderExamCentre(root,sec);
    window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'});
    const finishTitle=isToeic?'TOEIC CENTRE COMPLETE':`${name.toUpperCase()} COMPLETE`;
    const finishCopy=isToeic
      ?`<p>You have reached the end of the TOEIC Centre. All ${mods.length} modules remain available above for review.</p>`
      :`<p>You have reached the end of ${name}. All modules remain available above for review.</p>`;
    modal(finishTitle,'Well done.',`${finishCopy}<div class="rjx-actions"><button class="rjx-btn primary" id="examReview">Review modules</button><button class="rjx-btn" id="examMemberHome">Back to member area</button></div>`);
    document.getElementById('examReview').onclick=()=>closeModal();
    document.getElementById('examMemberHome').onclick=()=>{closeModal();show('member')};
  };
  document.getElementById('examBack').onclick=()=>{
    state.exam={sec,index:null};
    renderExamCentre(root,sec);
  };
  document.getElementById('examPrev').disabled=idx===0;
  const examNextBtn=document.getElementById('examNext');
  document.getElementById('examPrev').onclick=()=>{
    state.exam.index--;
    renderExamCentre(root,sec);
    window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'});
  };
  if(examNextBtn) examNextBtn.onclick=()=>{
    state.exam.index++;
    renderExamCentre(root,sec);
    window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'});
  };
}
function renderCueCards(root){let idx=0;function draw(){const c=RJX_CUES[idx];root.innerHTML=sectionCrumb('IELTS Cue Cards')+`<div class="rjx-practice-box"><div class="rjx-tag">${c[0]} · IELTS SPEAKING PART 2</div><h3>${c[1]}</h3><p>You should say:</p><ul>${c[2].map(x=>`<li>${x}</li>`).join('')}</ul><div class="rjx-actions"><button class="rjx-btn" id="prep">Start 1-minute preparation</button><button class="rjx-btn primary" id="speak2">Start 2-minute speaking</button></div><div class="rjx-timer" id="cueTimer">01:00</div></div><div class="rjx-bottom-nav"><button class="rjx-btn" id="cuePrev">← Previous card</button><span>Card ${idx+1} of ${RJX_CUES.length}</span><button class="rjx-btn primary next" id="cueNext">Next card →</button></div>`;wireCrumbs(root);document.getElementById('prep').onclick=()=>timed(60);document.getElementById('speak2').onclick=()=>timed(120);function timed(s){clearInterval(state.timer);const el=document.getElementById('cueTimer');let n=s;el.textContent=`${String(Math.floor(n/60)).padStart(2,'0')}:${String(n%60).padStart(2,'0')}`;state.timer=setInterval(()=>{n--;el.textContent=`${String(Math.floor(n/60)).padStart(2,'0')}:${String(n%60).padStart(2,'0')}`;if(n<=0){clearInterval(state.timer);el.textContent='TIME'}},1000)}document.getElementById('cuePrev').disabled=idx===0;document.getElementById('cueNext').disabled=idx===RJX_CUES.length-1;document.getElementById('cuePrev').onclick=()=>{idx--;draw()};document.getElementById('cueNext').onclick=()=>{idx++;draw()}}draw()}
function renderAI(root){
  let mode='Conversation', voiceOn=true, localModelSession=null, aiBusy=false;
  root.innerHTML=sectionCrumb('RJ AI Teacher')+`<div class="rjx-grid2"><div class="rjx-card"><div class="rjx-tag">AI PRACTICE MODES</div><h3>Choose a mode</h3><div class="rjx-tabs" id="aiModes">${['Conversation','Grammar','Vocabulary','IELTS','Pronunciation'].map((m,i)=>`<button class="rjx-tab ${i===0?'active':''}" data-ai-mode="${m}">${m}</button>`).join('')}</div><div class="rjx-note"><strong>Device-powered AI:</strong> RJ first checks whether this browser has an on-device language model available. If it does, the tutor uses it on the visitor’s own device. If not, RJ automatically falls back to built-in guided coaching so the practice area still works.</div><div class="rjx-ai-status" id="aiStatus">Checking this device for AI and voice support…</div></div><div class="rjx-card"><div class="rjx-chat" id="aiChat"><div class="rjx-bubble bot">Hello. Choose a mode and type something you would like to practise.</div></div><div class="rjx-chat-compose"><input class="rjx-input" id="aiInput" placeholder="Type your English here..."><button class="rjx-btn primary" id="aiSend">Send</button></div><div class="rjx-ai-tools"><button class="rjx-btn" id="aiMic">🎙 Speak</button><button class="rjx-btn" id="aiVoice">🔊 Voice on</button><button class="rjx-btn" id="aiRepeat">↻ Repeat reply</button><button class="rjx-btn" id="aiStop">■ Stop voice</button></div></div></div>`;
  wireCrumbs(root);
  const chat=document.getElementById('aiChat'), input=document.getElementById('aiInput'), status=document.getElementById('aiStatus');
  let lastReply='Hello. Choose a mode and type something you would like to practise.';
  const pickVoice=()=>{const vs=speechSynthesis.getVoices();return vs.find(v=>/^en-GB$/i.test(v.lang))||vs.find(v=>/^en/i.test(v.lang))||vs[0]||null};
  const speak=text=>{if(!voiceOn||!('speechSynthesis' in window)||!text)return;speechSynthesis.cancel();const u=new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);u.lang='en-GB';const v=pickVoice();if(v)u.voice=v;u.rate=.94;u.pitch=1;speechSynthesis.speak(u)};
  const escapeHtml=v=>v.replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
  const localReply=(m,v)=>{
    const words=v.trim().split(/\\s+/).filter(Boolean), wc=words.length, lower=v.toLowerCase();
    if(m==='Conversation') return wc<8?'Good start. Make it more natural by adding one reason, one detail and one example. Try saying the idea again in two or three complete sentences.':`That is a clearer answer. You used ${wc} words. Now develop it one step further: explain why it matters and add a specific example from real life.`;
    if(m==='Grammar'){
      if(/\\bi is\\b/i.test(v))return 'One correction: after “I”, use “am”, not “is”. Rewrite the sentence with “I am”, then add one extra detail.';
      if(/\\bhe have\\b|\\bshe have\\b|\\bit have\\b/i.test(v))return 'Check subject–verb agreement: with he, she or it in the present simple, use “has”. Rewrite it and then make a second example.';
      return 'Good. Check three things: verb tense, subject–verb agreement and word order. Now rewrite the sentence in a second natural way without changing the meaning.';
    }
    if(m==='Vocabulary') return 'Choose one general word in your sentence and replace it with something more precise. Then use that stronger word in a new sentence so you practise it in context.';
    if(m==='IELTS') return wc<25?'For IELTS, extend this answer. Use this structure: clear position, reason, specific example, then one concluding sentence. Aim for at least four connected sentences.':'This is moving toward an IELTS-style answer. Improve the band quality by making the example more specific and linking the ideas naturally instead of listing separate points.';
    if(m==='Pronunciation') return 'Practise it in three passes: first slowly, then with the main stressed words stronger, then once at natural speed. Use the Listen button to hear my model response in a British English voice where your browser provides one.';
    return 'Good work. Try it again with one extra detail.';
  };
  async function initDeviceAI(){
    let model='fallback';
    try{
      if(window.LanguageModel&&typeof LanguageModel.create==='function'){
        let availability=typeof LanguageModel.availability==='function'?await LanguageModel.availability(): 'available';
        if(availability!=='unavailable') {localModelSession=await LanguageModel.create({systemPrompt:'You are RJ AI Teacher, a concise supportive British English tutor. Correct errors clearly, explain briefly, and always give the learner one useful next action. Never claim abilities you do not have.'});model='browser-ai'}
      }else if(window.ai&&window.ai.languageModel&&typeof window.ai.languageModel.create==='function'){
        const caps=window.ai.languageModel.capabilities?await window.ai.languageModel.capabilities():{available:'readily'};
        if(caps.available!=='no'){localModelSession=await window.ai.languageModel.create({systemPrompt:'You are RJ AI Teacher, a concise supportive British English tutor. Correct errors clearly and give one next action.'});model='browser-ai'}
      }
    }catch(e){model='fallback'}
    const mic=!!(window.SpeechRecognition||window.webkitSpeechRecognition), tts='speechSynthesis' in window;
    status.innerHTML=model==='browser-ai'?`<strong>On-device AI available.</strong> ${tts?'Voice output ready.':'Voice output unavailable.'} ${mic?'Microphone input ready.':'Microphone dictation unavailable.'}`:`<strong>Guided tutor fallback active.</strong> This device does not expose a compatible on-device language model. ${tts?'Voice output is ready.':'Voice output is unavailable.'} ${mic?'Microphone dictation is ready.':'Microphone dictation is unavailable.'}`;
  }
  async function getReply(v){
    if(localModelSession){
      try{return await localModelSession.prompt(`Mode: ${mode}. Learner wrote: ${v}\\nGive a short British-English teaching response: correct any clear error, briefly explain it, and give one next practice step.`)}catch(e){return localReply(mode,v)}
    }
    return localReply(mode,v);
  }
  async function send(){
    const v=input.value.trim();if(!v||aiBusy)return;aiBusy=true;document.getElementById('aiSend').disabled=true;
    chat.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',`<div class="rjx-bubble user">${escapeHtml(v)}</div>`);input.value='';chat.scrollTop=chat.scrollHeight;
    chat.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend','<div class="rjx-bubble bot" id="aiThinking">Thinking…</div>');chat.scrollTop=chat.scrollHeight;
    const reply=await getReply(v);const th=document.getElementById('aiThinking');if(th)th.remove();lastReply=String(reply||localReply(mode,v));chat.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',`<div class="rjx-bubble bot">${escapeHtml(lastReply)}</div>`);chat.scrollTop=chat.scrollHeight;speak(lastReply);aiBusy=false;document.getElementById('aiSend').disabled=false;
  }
  root.querySelectorAll('[data-ai-mode]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{mode=b.dataset.aiMode;root.querySelectorAll('[data-ai-mode]').forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle('active',x===b))});
  document.getElementById('aiSend').onclick=send;input.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Enter'){e.preventDefault();send()}});
  document.getElementById('aiVoice').onclick=()=>{voiceOn=!voiceOn;document.getElementById('aiVoice').textContent=voiceOn?'🔊 Voice on':'🔇 Voice off';if(!voiceOn&&'speechSynthesis' in window)speechSynthesis.cancel()};
  document.getElementById('aiRepeat').onclick=()=>speak(lastReply);
  document.getElementById('aiMic').onclick=()=>{const SR=window.SpeechRecognition||window.webkitSpeechRecognition;if(!SR){status.innerHTML='<strong>Microphone dictation is not available in this browser.</strong> You can still type your answer.';return}const r=new SR();r.lang='en-GB';r.interimResults=false;r.maxAlternatives=1;r.onresult=e=>{input.value=e.results[0][0].transcript;input.focus()};r.onerror=()=>{status.innerHTML='<strong>Microphone input could not start.</strong> Check browser microphone permission or type your answer instead.'};r.start()};
  initDeviceAI();
}

function renderGeneric(root,sec){
  const data=RJX_MEMBER_MODULES;
  const d=data[sec]||[sec,'Member content',[]];
  root.innerHTML=sectionCrumb(d[0])+`<div class="rjx-head"><div><h2>${d[0]}</h2><p>${d[1]}</p></div></div><div class="rjx-grid3">${d[2].map((x,i)=>`<div class="rjx-card click" data-gen="${i}"><div class="rjx-tag">MODULE ${i+1} OF ${d[2].length}</div><h3>${x}</h3><p>Open this module for explanation, examples, guided practice and review.</p><span class="rjx-link">Open module →</span></div>`).join('')}</div>`;
  wireCrumbs(root);
  root.querySelectorAll('[data-gen]').forEach(c=>c.onclick=()=>renderGenericDetail(root,sec,+c.dataset.gen));
}

Make one affirmative, one negative and one question.',q:'Which sentence sounds correct?',opts:['She has worked here since 2024.','She works here since 2024.'],correct:0},
    vocabulary:{lead:'Build useful vocabulary through meaning, natural combinations and real-life examples.',examples:['make a decision','strong opinion','catch a train'],task:'Choose five useful items from this module and write one natural sentence for each.',q:'Which combination is natural English?',opts:['make a decision','do a decision'],correct:0},
    pronunciation:{lead:'Focus on the sound or rhythm first, then practise slowly before building natural speed.',examples:['think / this','REcord / reCORD','I WANT to GO.'],task:'Say each example slowly three times, then repeat it once at natural speaking speed.',q:'Which approach is best for pronunciation practice?',opts:['Slow, accurate practice before natural speed','Speak as fast as possible immediately'],correct:0},

Try to give at least one reason and one example.',q:'Which answer structure usually sounds more developed?',opts:['Answer + reason + example','One-word answer only'],correct:0},
    quizzes:{lead:'Test the skill, check the feedback, then retry the pattern you missed.',examples:['Read carefully','Choose one answer','Review the explanation'],task:'Complete the quick check below, then move to the next quiz module.',q:'Choose the natural sentence.',opts:['I am interested in learning English.','I am interesting in learn English.'],correct:0},
    games:{lead:'Use speed and repetition to make accurate English feel more automatic.',examples:['Match quickly','Repair the sentence','Beat your previous score'],task:'Give yourself 45 seconds: create three correct sentences connected with this challenge topic.',q:'Which phrase is natural?',opts:['take a break','make a break'],correct:0},
    downloads:{lead:'Use this study pack as a focused revision session rather than a passive reading page.',examples:['Study notes','Worked examples','Practice checklist'],task:'Work through the pack outline below and mark each part when completed.',q:'What is the best way to use a study pack?',opts:['Study, practise and review','Read the title and stop'],correct:0},
    weekly:{lead:'This week’s challenge combines a short learning point with a task you can complete today.',examples:['Learn','Try','Check'],task:'Complete the challenge once without help, review your answer, then improve it a second time.',q:'What should you do after your first attempt?',opts:['Review and improve it','Never look at it again'],correct:0},
    newsletter:{lead:'Catch up on Academy updates and turn each update into a small piece of English practice.',examples:['New lesson','Tip of the month','Resource spotlight'],task:'Choose one update below and write two sentences about how you could use it in your English study.',q:'Which habit supports steady progress?',opts:['Short regular practice','Only studying once every few months'],correct:0},
    'gold-downloads':{lead:'Gold resources go deeper with larger, more specialised study sessions.',examples:['Advanced notes','Extended practice','Self-review'],task:'Choose one section from this resource and complete a focused 15-minute study block.',q:'Which is the stronger study approach?',opts:['Focused practice followed by review','Opening the resource without using it'],correct:0}
  };
  const m=library[sec]||library.grammar;

    <article class="rjx-lesson">
      <div class="rjx-lesson-head"><div class="rjx-tag">${d[0].toUpperCase()} · MODULE ${index+1}</div><h2>${title}</h2><p>${m.lead}</p></div>
      <div class="rjx-lesson-body">
        <h3>Learn</h3><p>${m.lead} This module is designed as a complete study screen, so you can move from explanation into practice without hitting a dead end.</p>
        <h3>Examples</h3><div class="rjx-checklist">${m.examples.map(x=>`<div class="rjx-check">${x}</div>`).join('')}</div>
        <h3>Guided practice</h3><p>${m.task}</p><textarea class="rjx-input" style="min-height:110px;resize:vertical" placeholder="Write your answer or study notes here..."></textarea>
        <h3>Quick check</h3><p>${m.q}</p><div class="rjx-options">${m.opts.map((o,i)=>`<button class="rjx-option" data-gen-answer="${i}">${o}</button>`).join('')}</div><div class="rjx-feedback" id="genFb"></div>
      </div>
    </article>
    <div class="rjx-bottom-nav"><button class="rjx-btn" id="genBack">← Back to ${d[0]}</button><span>Module ${index+1} of ${d[1].length}</span><div class="rjx-actions">${index>0?'<button class="rjx-btn" id="genPrev">← Previous</button>':''}${index<d[1].length-1?'<button class="rjx-btn primary next" id="genNext">Next module →</button>':'<span class="rjx-chip">FINAL MODULE ✓</span>'}</div></div>`;
  wireCrumbs(root);
  const answers=[...root.querySelectorAll('[data-gen-answer]')];
  answers.forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{if(answers.some(x=>x.disabled))return;const chosen=+b.dataset.genAnswer;answers.forEach((x,i)=>{x.disabled=true;if(i===m.correct)x.classList.add('correct')});if(chosen===m.correct){window.rjxPlayCorrect?.();document.getElementById('genFb').textContent='Correct — well done.'}else{b.classList.add('wrong');window.rjxPlayWrong?.();document.getElementById('genFb').textContent=`Not quite. The best answer is: ${m.opts[m.correct]}`};document.getElementById('genFb').classList.add('show')});
  document.getElementById('genBack').onclick=()=>renderGeneric(root,sec);
  const genPrev=document.getElementById('genPrev'),genNext=document.getElementById('genNext');
  if(genPrev)genPrev.onclick=()=>renderGenericDetail(root,sec,index-1);
  if(genNext)genNext.onclick=()=>renderGenericDetail(root,sec,index+1);
}


function renderProgress(root,sec){const s=storage(),done=Object.keys(s.done||{}).length,mist=(s.mistakes||[]).length;root.innerHTML=sectionCrumb(sec==='dashboard'?'Personal Dashboard':'Saved Progress')+`<div class="rjx-stat-grid"><div class="rjx-stat"><span>Completed items</span><b>${done}</b></div><div class="rjx-stat"><span>Saved mistakes</span><b>${mist}</b></div><div class="rjx-stat"><span>Current level</span><b>B1</b></div><div class="rjx-stat"><span>Recommended</span><b>${mist?'Review':'Continue'}</b></div></div><div class="rjx-head"><div><h2>Recent learning</h2><p>Progress is saved locally in this preview browser.</p></div></div><div class="rjx-card"><p>${s.last?`Last completed item: <strong>${s.last}</strong>`:'Complete a lesson or practice activity and it will appear here.'}</p></div>`;wireCrumbs(root)}
function renderAdaptive(root){const bank=[['Choose the correct first conditional.',['If it rains, we will stay home.','If it will rain, we stay home.'],0],['Choose the natural collocation.',['make a decision','do a decision'],0],['Which is correct?',['She has lived here since 2020.','She lives here since 2020.'],0],['Choose the best connector.',['However,','Because however'],0],['Which phrase is more natural?',['I strongly agree.','I heavy agree.'],0]];let i=0,score=0;function draw(){const q=bank[i];root.innerHTML=sectionCrumb('Adaptive Practice')+`<div class="rjx-practice-box"><div class="rjx-tag">ADAPTIVE ROUND</div><h3>Question ${i+1} of ${bank.length}</h3><p>${q[0]}</p><div class="rjx-options">${q[1].map((o,j)=>`<button class="rjx-option" data-ad="${j}">${o}</button>`).join('')}</div><div class="rjx-feedback" id="adFb"></div></div>`;wireCrumbs(root);root.querySelectorAll('[data-ad]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{const ok=+b.dataset.ad===q[2];if(ok){score++;window.rjxPlayCorrect?.()}else{window.rjxPlayWrong?.();addMistake('adaptive-'+i,q[0],q[1][q[2]],'Review this pattern before the next adaptive round.')}i++;if(i<bank.length)draw();else root.innerHTML=sectionCrumb('Adaptive Practice')+`<div class="rjx-card"><div class="rjx-tag">ROUND COMPLETE</div><h3>${score}/${bank.length}</h3><p>Your result is now available for the Platinum recommendation system.</p><button class="rjx-btn primary" id="again">Start another round</button></div>`,document.getElementById('again').onclick=()=>{i=0;score=0;draw()}})}draw()}
function renderRevision(root){
  const s=storage(),m=s.mistakes||[];
  root.innerHTML=sectionCrumb('Mistake Revision')+`<div class="rjx-head"><div><h2>Your saved mistakes</h2><p>Incorrect answers from lessons, practice and adaptive work return here. Open any item to actively correct it.</p></div></div>${m.length?`<div class="rjx-list">${m.map((x,i)=>`<button class="rjx-row" data-revise="${i}" style="width:100%;text-align:left;border:0"><div><strong>${x.q}</strong><small>Correct answer: ${x.answer} · ${x.why}</small></div><span class="rjx-chip">Review →</span></button>`).join('')}</div><div id="revisionWork" style="margin-top:16px"></div>`:`<div class="rjx-card"><p>No saved mistakes yet. Answer a lesson or practice question incorrectly and it will appear here.</p><button class="rjx-btn primary" id="revPractice">Start adaptive practice →</button></div>`}`;
  wireCrumbs(root);
  if(!m.length){document.getElementById('revPractice').onclick=()=>{state.section='adaptive';renderSection()};return}
  root.querySelectorAll('[data-revise]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{
    const i=+b.dataset.revise,x=m[i];
    document.getElementById('revisionWork').innerHTML=`<div class="rjx-practice-box"><div class="rjx-tag">MISTAKE REVIEW ${i+1}</div><h3>${x.q}</h3><p><strong>Correct answer:</strong> ${x.answer}</p><p>${x.why}</p><textarea class="rjx-input" id="revAnswer" style="min-height:100px;resize:vertical" placeholder="Rewrite the correct answer or make your own example using the same pattern..."></textarea><div class="rjx-actions" style="margin-top:12px"><button class="rjx-btn primary" id="revDone">Mark reviewed</button><button class="rjx-btn" id="revNext">Next saved mistake →</button></div><div class="rjx-feedback" id="revFb"></div></div>`;
    document.getElementById('revDone').onclick=()=>{markDone('revision-'+(x.id||i));const f=document.getElementById('revFb');f.textContent='Reviewed. Try to use the corrected pattern again later today.';f.classList.add('show');window.rjxPlayCorrect?.()};
    document.getElementById('revNext').disabled=i===m.length-1;
    document.getElementById('revNext').onclick=()=>{const n=root.querySelector(`[data-revise="${i+1}"]`);n&&n.click()};
  });
}
function renderPathways(root){
  const paths=[['30-Day Confidence Builder','Daily speaking, grammar and vocabulary with weekly checkpoints.'],['IELTS Speaking Programme','Part 1, Part 2, Part 3, vocabulary and mock practice.'],['B1 to B2 Bridge','Grammar, vocabulary, reading, writing and speaking checkpoints.']];
  root.innerHTML=sectionCrumb('Learning Pathways')+`<div class="rjx-grid2">${paths.map((p,i)=>`<div class="rjx-card"><div class="rjx-tag">PROGRAMME ${i+1}</div><h3>${p[0]}</h3><p>${p[1]}</p><div class="rjx-progress-track" style="margin:12px 0"><div class="rjx-progress-bar" style="width:0%"></div></div><button class="rjx-btn primary" data-path="${i}">Start programme →</button></div>`).join('')}</div>`;
  wireCrumbs(root);root.querySelectorAll('[data-path]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>renderPathwayDetail(root,+b.dataset.path));
}
